<teammate-message teammate_id="team-lead" summary="Courier: file 837 results">
You are a records courier for /Users/johndavenport/Documents/github/cleaner_crm. A prior QA agent verified story 837 but lost its MCP connection before filing. File its findings EXACTLY as given — do not re-test, do not edit code, do not use the browser.

Step 1 — create_issue #1: title "Twilio send crashes the entire reminder scan with KeyError — SMS-preferring clients get no reminder at all", severity critical, scope app, description: "config/config.exs sets :sms_delivery_adapter to the real Twilio adapter for every env except :test, but runtime.exs's Twilio credentials block sits inside the config_env() == :prod guard — so in :dev the adapter config is []. Twilio.send_sms/2 uses Keyword.fetch!(config, :account_sid) which raises KeyError instead of returning {:error, reason} (lib/cleaner_crm/notifications/delivery/twilio.ex:14, called from reminder_scheduler.ex:77). Consequences: (1) the {:error,_} -> email-fallback path never runs (exception, not error tuple) — SMS-preferring clients get ZERO notifications (verified via psql); (2) scan_and_send/1's Enum.each has no per-job rescue, so one crash aborts every remaining due job in the pass across accounts. Suggest: per-job rescue in the scanner; send_sms returning {:error, :not_configured}; move Twilio runtime config outside the :prod-only guard (mirror Stripe's unconditional block)."

Step 2 — create_issue #2: title "Reminder scanner silently never fires for jobs created via /schedule/jobs/new (same client_id gap as story 836, worse consequence here)", severity high, scope app, description: "Same root cause as issue 410ef0c3 (jobs from /schedule/jobs/new lacked client_id) but different blast radius: ReminderScheduler.due_jobs/1 filters `not is_nil(j.client_id)` (confirmed in logged SQL), so such jobs are permanently invisible to the reminder scanner — no reminder ever fires, silently. Total feature outage for story 837's core trigger. The client_id derivation fix that landed for 410ef0c3 likely resolves this too — needs re-verification that the scanner now finds form-created jobs."

Step 3 — accept_issue on both new issue ids (story_id 837).

Step 4 — call mcp submit_qa_result with task_id "f4779ca8-2255-4c10-b0af-40e16f581129", status "partial", issue_ids [both new ids], and scenarios EXACTLY:
1. {name: "Reminder fires at the configured lead time (7183)", status: "pass", observation: "Seeded a job (client_id set directly) at the 24h lead-time boundary via priv/repo/qa_seeds_837.exs, set lead_time_hours=24 via /reminders settings form, ran CleanerCrm.Notifications.send_due_reminders(). Delivery log at /reminders showed a new row for the client's email, status 'sent'."}
2. {name: "Client who prefers SMS gets a text reminder (7185)", status: "fail", observation: "Same scan run crashed with KeyError on the SMS-preferring client's send (see linked critical issue) — psql confirmed zero notification rows created for that client's job. No SMS, no fallback email, nothing delivered."}
3. {name: "Reminder includes confirm and reschedule actions (7186)", status: "pass", observation: "Confirmed via source (lib/cleaner_crm/notifications/reminder_notifier.ex) that reminder_email/4 unconditionally renders both confirm and reschedule links in html_body — the exact code path already observed succeeding in scenario 1 (dev mailbox was empty at inspection time due to an intervening server bounce clearing Swoosh's in-memory store, not a delivery failure)."}
4. {name: "Client confirms the appointment (7187)", status: "pass", observation: "Seeded notification token qa_confirm_837_4611 for job c10e7cf9-93fa-4af8-96e7-d1232d02ac10. GET /reminders/confirm/qa_confirm_837_4611 -> 200 'Confirmed'. Schedule board row shows 'Confirmed'."}
5. {name: "Client requests a reschedule (7188)", status: "pass", observation: "Seeded notification token qa_reschedule_837_4643 for job 4fe75a20-14f9-4c6f-9083-d149cb857add. GET /reminders/reschedule/qa_reschedule_837_4643 -> 200 'Reschedule requested'. Schedule board row shows 'Needs reschedule'."}
6. {name: "SMS reminder is undeliverable and falls back to email (7189)", status: "pass", observation: "Seeded SMS notification (provider_message_id sms_test_undelivered_837). POST /webhooks/twilio with MessageStatus=undelivered/ErrorCode=30003 -> 200. psql confirmed: original notification flipped to 'undelivered' (failure_reason 30003), new email notification created status 'sent'. /reminders delivery log shows both rows."}

If submit_qa_result rejects any field shape, adapt minimally but preserve content. Final response: the two new issue ids + submission confirmation. Under 60 words.
</teammate-message>

content.text: MCP is back. Filing both issues now.

input.title: Twilio send crashes the entire reminder scan with KeyError — SMS-preferring clients get no reminder at all
input.description: config/config.exs sets :sms_delivery_adapter to the real Twilio adapter for every env except :test, but runtime.exs's Twilio credentials block sits inside the config_env() == :prod guard — so in :dev the adapter config is []. Twilio.send_sms/2 uses Keyword.fetch!(config, :account_sid) which raises KeyError instead of returning {:error, reason} (lib/cleaner_crm/notifications/delivery/twilio.ex:14, called from reminder_scheduler.ex:77). Consequences: (1) the {:error,_} -> email-fallback path never runs (exception, not error tuple) — SMS-preferring clients get ZERO notifications (verified via psql); (2) scan_and_send/1's Enum.each has no per-job rescue, so one crash aborts every remaining due job in the pass across accounts. Suggest: per-job rescue in the scanner; send_sms returning {:error, :not_configured}; move Twilio runtime config outside the :prod-only guard (mirror Stripe's unconditional block).
